name: What should I do to prepare my home before a guest bathroom remodel begins?

mainEntity.name: What should I do to prepare my home before a guest bathroom remodel begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your guest bathroom remodel starts, clear out all personal items from the bathroom, including toiletries, decor, and anything stored in cabinets or on shelves. Ensure there is a clear path for workers to access the bathroom and protect any nearby flooring or furniture with drop cloths. It's also beneficial to discuss temporary restroom arrangements with your household, especially if it's your only bathroom. This preparation helps ensure a smooth start to the project and protects your belongings.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before remodeling, remove all personal items from the bathroom, ensure clear access for workers, and protect nearby areas. Discuss temporary restroom plans with your household to prepare for project start.
